marks.gloss_en: מתניתין נמי דייקא -- R' Meir's reason is 'since it was slaughtered not by an expert', not that the blemish is in doubt: he penalizes
conclude from it: R' Meir imposes a penalty
תא שמע -- מדקאמר ליה 'בא ואראך', מכלל דאיכא דמשתני ואיכא דלא משתני
R' Yoshiya of Usha [to Rabba bar bar Chana]: come and I will show you corneal blemishes that change
(asked) 'because of those that change' -- all of them [corneal blemishes] change
the practical difference: contradicting witnesses [who say the eye had the blemish in life] -- if all change, they are liars; if some do and some do not, we rely on them
R' Akiva: every expert for the court is exempt from paying
רבי טרפון, אתה מומחה לבית דין, וכל המומחה לבית דין פטור מלשלם
[R' Tarfon] erred in a matter of mishna
(R' Akiva, per the stam) and even if you erred in weighing discretion
[one who] judged a case -- acquitted the liable or convicted the innocent, declared the pure impure or the impure pure: what he did is done
אלא זיכה את החייב היכי דמי? אי דאמר ליה 'פטור אתה' -- והא לא נשא ונתן ביד!
כגון שהיה לו משכון ונטלו הימנו -- the pledge case, in which he did take by hand
granted, 'obligated the innocent' -- where he took and gave with his hand
(entertained) the anonymous mishna follows R' Meir, who imposes liability for indirect damage
'declared the pure impure' -- where he made a creeping thing touch them
the incident: a cow whose womb was removed, and R' Tarfon fed it to the dogs
Todos the physician: no cow or sow leaves Alexandria of Egypt unless they cut its womb, so that it not give birth
one who takes a wage to examine firstborns -- one does not slaughter on his word unless he was an expert, like Ila in Yavne
אי הכי, לפום פסידא לישלם! -- if the rate follows the loss, let him pay according to the actual loss
משום גזירת מגדלי בהמה דקה נגעו בה (in the name of Rav Acha bar Ika)
on account of the decree on those who raise small livestock, they touched it [lowered the small animal's rate]
when he pays, he pays a quarter for a small animal
one who is not an expert examined the firstborn and it was slaughtered on his ruling: it is to be buried
